content.Title: 2023 AHA/ACC/ACCP/ASPC/ILNA/PCNA Chronic Coronary Disease Guideline

Figures.Description: The map displays age-adjusted U.S. prevalence of individuals who have been told they have angina or coronary heart disease (CHD) by state (BRFSS data, 2019).
The map illustrates the global age-adjusted prevalence of chronic coronary disease (CCD) per 100,000 people by sex in 2020.

Sources: BRFSS indicates Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System
CHD refers to coronary heart disease
CCD stands for chronic coronary disease
Notes: Reprinted and modified with permission from American Heart Association and University of Washington's Global Burden of Disease Study.
